description: Server-side Fabric mod that freezes your Minecraft server until every required player is online.

mods.name: No Player Left Behind
mods.description:
Freezes the server until every required player is online.
Pause your SMP or co-op world whenever a friend is offline, so nobody plays ahead of the group.
Wait for all players to join before the game runs: no mobs, crops, time, or item progress while someone is missing.
Made for friend groups, duo and trio survival worlds, and fair multiplayer progression.

releases.notes:
Server-side Fabric mod that freezes your server until every required player is online.

**Requirements**
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer
- Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or newer
- Java 25 or newer

Install on the server only.

See the [README](https://github.com/Jc-42/no-player-left-behind#readme) for configuration and commands.

Looking for Minecraft 1.21.11? Use the [legacy release](https://github.com/Jc-42/no-player-left-behind/releases/tag/v1.0.0%2B1.21.11).
